inventory_reservation_consistent.name: inventory_reservation_consistent
inventory_reservation_consistent.value: (status <> 'RESERVED') OR (reserved_for_type IS NOT NULL AND reserved_for_id IS NOT NULL)

product_sku_pool_nonneg.name: product_sku_pool_nonneg
product_sku_pool_nonneg.value: pooled_quantity >= 0 AND pooled_reserved >= 0 AND pooled_reserved <= pooled_quantity

pack_outcome_qty_range.name: pack_outcome_qty_range
pack_outcome_qty_range.value: quantity_remaining >= 0 AND quantity_remaining <= quantity_total AND quantity_total > 0

raffle_schedule.name: raffle_schedule
raffle_schedule.value: closes_at > opens_at AND draws_at >= closes_at AND claim_deadline_at > draws_at
